candidates.name: 동글 단골형
candidates.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: polished standalone mascot redesign candidate for the Korean Time Black Market web app.
Input image: brand reference ONLY. Look at the mole shopkeeper in panel 03 of the supplied brand board for identity and palette. Ignore all the page layouts, signage, letters, other panels and UI. The deliverable is ONLY one redesigned full-body mole character, not a sheet or a website.
Primary request: The current mascot feels visually disorganized. Redesign it with professional visual hierarchy, a coherent silhouette and anatomy, clean purposeful shapes, carefully separated facial features, and fewer details. Friendly but sly neighborhood corner-store proprietor who sells time on credit.
Identity: an actual anthropomorphic MOLE, warm taupe/brown fur, modest rounded protruding pink mole nose, small dark sunglasses, black-brown fedora with a brick-red ribbon, forest-green shopkeeper apron, one very small gold tooth in a warm crooked smile. No visible cat ears or bear ears. Broad simplified digging paws and tiny feet. The hat brim must sit ABOVE the sunglasses with visible forehead separating them. The glasses, nose and mouth must remain distinct and never merge. Simplify whiskers away. Plain apron, no patch, no cross emblem.
Brand palette: dark chocolate #302B24, taupe #A78260, light muzzle #D1AE83, brick red #AD382B, forest green #46715A, muted pink #DE8A84, tiny mustard gold #E5B853, cream #FFF4D9.
Composition: one character centered, entire body and hat visible, occupying about 75 percent of a square canvas with generous clear margins. Transparent background. At most ONE prop: a small closed brick-red ledger, no writing, naturally tucked under an arm or held in one paw. The other paw should be relaxed or make one simple welcoming gesture.
Constraints: a clear memorable mascot readable as a 48px avatar and as a large character. Premium finished character art. No text, no numbers, no labels, no speech bubbles, no logo, no borders, no extra characters, no storefront, no scattered accessories, no hourglass prop, no coins or sparkles, no noisy fur detail, no watermarks.
Direction 01 — ROUNDED FLAT MASCOT. Very simple generous round head with a clearly protruding short mole snout and compact egg-shaped body, about 2.2 heads tall. Soft friendly proportions and a calm confident smile. Clean vector-like flat color fills, consistent medium chocolate outlines with rounded joins, no texture, almost no shading. The little ledger rests under one arm and the other digging paw makes a small easy wave. The apron has one continuous clean shape. Emphasis on lovable, highly legible silhouette and uncluttered geometry.
